question: In which year was the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award officially renamed the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was officially renamed the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in the year **2021**.
 
• This decision was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on **6th August 2021**, to honor the legacy of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• The renaming was a tribute to Major Dhyan Chand, widely regarded as one of the greatest hockey players in history and a key contributor to India's success in the sport.
 
• The Khel Ratna Award is the **highest sporting honor in India**, awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The renaming aimed to shift the focus towards honoring sports excellence and the achievements of Indian athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**:

 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand, known as the "Wizard of Hockey," is celebrated for his exceptional skills and contribution to Indian hockey.
 
• He helped India secure gold medals in the 1928, 1932, and 1936 Olympics, establishing the nation's dominance in the sport.
 
• The renaming of the award in his honor underscores his unparalleled legacy and the importance of sports in national pride.
